metadata.name: GetCardholderTransactionHistory
metadata.description: This API is used to get Transaction History based on history type.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Account Number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Condition:At least one of AccountNumber/AccountID is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Admin Number. Valid Values:0-9 Example:7485122

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Valid Values:0-9 Example:7485122 Condition:At least one of AccountNumber/AccountID is required.

request_fields.name: FromDate
request_fields.description: Starting date of Transaction search. Valid Values:01/15/2020 Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: ToDate
request_fields.description: End date of Transaction search. Valid Values:01/15/2020 Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: TransactionType
request_fields.description: Type of Transaction. Valid Values:0 = All,1 = ATM,3 = Fees,4 = Purchase,7 = Transfers,8 = Disputed,9 = Payments,10 = Payment Reversals Example:Fees/Purchase/ATM. Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: TransactionID
request_fields.description: Transaction ID of a Transaction. Example:8574152.

request_fields.name: TransactionHistoryType
request_fields.description: Type of Transaction's History. Valid Values:1,2,3,4,5 Example:0=All,1 = Settled, 2 = OutStanding , 3 = Expired, 4 = Warehoused , 5 = Unbilled

request_fields.name: Merchant
request_fields.description: Name of the Merchant. Valid Values:a-z,0-9 Example:Wallmart Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MinTransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Minimum Transaction Amount on the Account. Valid Values:0-9 Example:200.00

request_fields.name: MaxTransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Maximum Transaction Amount on the Account. Valid Values:0-9 Example:200.00

request_fields.name: BatchSize
request_fields.description: Number of Transaction which can be view in one Batch. BatchSize can have value 1-100,On the basis of PageIndex and BatchSize paging will be done. BatchSize can not exceed 100. Default Batch Size should be 100. Valid Values:0-100 Example:10,50.

request_fields.name: PageIndex
request_fields.description: Number of page. PageIndex can not exceed 999. Valid Values:0-999 Example:1.

request_fields.name: IdentifierToken
request_fields.description: A generated token that is not expired can be used as an input field to access API. If we are passing this field in input, user should not pass any other account identifier. Condition:At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 800

request_fields.name: AMEXTID
request_fields.description: A unique number given by the Network to identify a Cardmember Transaction throughout its life cycle. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: 999999999999999 Example: 253652365985632 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: TransactionLifeCycleUniqueID
request_fields.description: Lifecycle Transaction ID of a Transaction.This is the unique id for all types of transactions including dispute, clearing, reversal etc. Valid Values: 0 - 9,a-z Format:  0000xxxx Example: ABC8574152 Allowable Values: 25

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: PostingReference

children.name: TransactionSource

children.name: TransactionDescription

children.name: CurrentBalance

children.name: TransactionHistoryType

children.name: ReverseFlag

children.name: SendChargebackFlag
children.description: Flag for Chargeback.

children.name: ResolveDispute
children.description: Flag is use to Resolve disputed transaction.

children.name: CancelDispute
children.description: Flag is use to Cancel Dispute transaction.

children.name: DisputeReason
children.description: This is use to DisputRegon.

children.name: DisputeOTBReleaseFlag
children.description: Release OTB for Disputed Amount.

children.name: VROLCaseNumber
children.description: CaseNumber stamped to a Dispute case by VROL system. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 12121

children.name: CardPresenceIndicator
children.description: It shows if the Card is present at the time of transaction or not. Valid Values: 0-Card Not Present, 1-Card Present Example: 1

children.name: PreAuthTimestamp
children.description: Date and Time when cardholder swipe the card to make transaction. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 10:11:01

children.name: LocalTransactionCurrencyCode
children.description: This is the local currency Code of the acquirer or source location of the transaction. It specifies the currency used in DE 4 (Amount, Transaction). Example:840-USD Allowable Values: 10

children.name: CardholderBillingCurrencyCode
children.description: Cardholder Billing currency code. Example:840-USD Allowable Values: 10

children.name: SettlementCurrencyCode
children.description: Settlement Currency Code. Example:840-USD Allowable Values: 10

children.name: CardholderBillingAmount
children.description: Cardholder Billing Amount. Example:100.00

children.name: TransactionSourceAmount
children.description: Transaction Amount at Source. Example:100.00

children.name: HoldStatus
children.description: Status of the Hold Payment. Valid Values: 0 = On-Hold 1 = Released Automatically 2 = Released Manually 3 = Payment Reversed Example:0

children.name: HoldReleaseDate
children.description: Actual date and time when the payment hold is released. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example:01/01/2021 12:00:01

children.name: TransactionLifeCycleUniqueID
children.description: A unique ID for Transaction Lifecycle. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 123456

children.name: AcquirerReferenceNumber
children.description: ARN (Acquirer Reference Number) is a unique number that tags a credit card transaction when it goes from the merchenats bank (the acquiring bank) through the card scheme to the cardholder. Valid Values: 0-99

children.name: SchemeTransactionID
children.description: Scheme Transaction Id is a special set of numbers that defines each transaction

children.name: MerchantFraudScore
children.description: Description: This Tag Determines the Fraud Score of the Merchant through which the Transaction Occurred. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX Example: 60

children.name: STIPTransaction
children.description: Description: Whenever a Transaction decisioning is done by association STIP Service, for such Transactions, this Tag must return as “Yes” and if Transaction decisioning is done by issuer then this Tag must return as “No”. Valid Values: Yes and No Format: XXX Example: Yes

children.name: AMEXTID
children.description: A unique number given by the Network to identify a Cardmember Transaction throughout its life cycle. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: 999999999999999 Example: 253652365985632 Allowable Values: 15

children.name: ECIUCAFIndicator
children.description: This displays the Auth transaction type as per ISO Standard i.e., ECI/UCAF Valid Values: 05 - Secure electronic commerce transaction Format: ECI/UCAF Code with Description of code Example: 01 = Final Authorization

children.name: CardSequenceNumber
children.description: This tag reflects the SequenceNumber of the Card.Example: 02 Valid Values: 0-9 Format: 99 Example: 02

children.name: IsSafeReported
children.description: Indicates if for Fraudulent disputed transaction safe is reported or not.Only applicable to MasterCard/AMEX disputed transaction with Fraud reason. Valid Values:  0=No, 1= Yes, 2= Not Applicable Example:  1 Allowable Values: 15

children.name: TransactionFraudStatus
children.description: Represent Transaction status either Fraudulent or Non-Fraudulent. Valid Values: 1 = Fraudulent and 0 = Not Fraudulent Example: 1

children.name: ThirdPartyFraudAction
children.description: Represent Feedzai Action recieved from Feedzai Example: Approve

children.name: ThirdPartyFraudScore
children.description: Represent Feedzai Score recieved from Feedzai Example: 189

children.name: DateTimeLocalTransaction
children.description: This tag should display the local transaction date and time received in the authorization request. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

children.name: EnrichedMerchantName
children.description: Name of Merchant. Valid Values: 0-9,A-Z Example: Revolution 12 Store Allowable Values: 50

children.name: EnrichedMerchantLogo
children.description: Logo of Merchant.

children.name: EnrichedMerchantLocationLatitude
children.description: The latitude coordinates of the merchant store location. This is enriched data coming from the Network. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 37.7661 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: EnrichedMerchantLocationLongitude
children.description: The longitude coordinates of merchant store location. This is enriched data coming from the Network. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: -122.3958 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: EnrichedMerchantStreetAddress
children.description: Street Address of the merchant. This is enriched data coming from the Network. Valid Values: 0-9 and A-Z Example: 1814 Central Ave Allowable Values: 100

children.name: EnrichedMerchantCity
children.description: The city of the merchant store location. This is enriched data coming from the Network. Valid Values: A-Z Example: Albany Allowable Values: 50

children.name: EnrichedMerchantPostalCode
children.description: The postal code of the merchant store location. This is enriched data coming from the Network. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 12345 Allowable Values: 20

children.name: EnrichedMerchantCountry
children.description: The country of the merchant store location. This is enriched data coming from the Network. Valid Values: A-Z Example: United States Allowable Values: 50

children.name: EnrichedMerchantWebsite
children.description: Website of the merchant store location. This is enriched data coming from the Network. Valid Values: 0-9, A-Z and period characters Example: www.abc.com Allowable Values: 50

children.name: FirstFraudRuleAndAction
children.description: Feedzai Primary action Code and Rule Example: PSD2-Art-18

children.name: OtherFraudRuleAndAction
children.description: Feedzai Secondary action Code and Rule Example: txn as rnt of lim

children.name: SecondaryCardUsageLimit
children.description: The SecondaryCardUsageLimit is a predefined spending cap assigned to a specific card, typically used to restrict the card's spending to a certain limit. This tag will return value if the Product Type is Commercial Card Type and history is filtered for a Specific Card. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 125.50

children.name: UtilizedCardLimit
children.description: The UtilizedCardLimit is the total amount of transactions made on a specific card. This feature is available for Commercial Card Type products when transactions are filtered by Card. For cards with limits that reset periodically, the UtilizedCardLimit will reset to zero at the start of each defined period. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 125.50

children.name: FraudSystemActionCode
children.description: Action code setup on the Product. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ThreeDSAuthResultsCode
children.description: 3-D Secure Authentication Results Code (padded with a leading zero). Example: "07" Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AuthenticationMethod
children.description: Method used by Issuer ACS for authentication. Example: "08" for OOB with App login Allowable Values: 10

children.name: CavvKeyIndicator
children.description: Indicates which CAVV key was used (padded with leading zero). Example: "01" Allowable Values: 10

children.name: CavvValue
children.description: 3-digit code generated by ACS. Example: "123" Allowable Values: 10

children.name: SeedValue
children.description: 4-digit value created by the ACS. Example: "8354" Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AuthenticationAmount
children.description: Amount from Authentication Request, converted to 5-byte value. Example: "000123" Allowable Values: 20

children.name: AuthenticationCurrencyCode
children.description: 3-digit currency code from Authentication Request. Example: "840" (USD) Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AuthenticationDateJulian
children.description: Julian Day of authentication date (based on UTC/GMT, no year). Example: "056" for Feb 25 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: CavvVersion3dsProtocolVersion
children.description: Composite nibble of CAVV Version and 3DS Protocol Version. Example: "75" (Version 7 CAVV with EMV 3DS 2.2.x) Allowable Values: 10

children.name: InformationalData
children.description: Optional field: Merchant ID, IP address (in hex), or zero-filled. Example: "0000000000" or "4D45524348414E54" Allowable Values: 20

children.name: AuthTransmissionDateTime
children.description: Date and Time when Auth was Transmitted. Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

children.name: AvailableBalance
children.description: The available balance

children.name: CurrentBalance
children.description: The current balance

children.name: LastTransactionDate
children.description: The last transaction date

children.name: LastCreditDate
children.description: The last credit date

children.name: LastCreditAmount
children.description: The last credit amount

children.name: LastPaymentDate
children.description: The last payment date
